original:
सत्यं शौचं दया दानं धर्मो हि दशधोच्यते ।
नागरखण्डकथिते धर्मे सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
sanskrit:
सत्यं शौचं दया दानं धर्मो हि दशधोच्यते ।
नागरखण्डकथिते धर्मे सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम् ॥
transliteration:
satyaṃ śaucaṃ dayā dānaṃ dharmo hi daśadhocyate |
nāgarakhaṇḍakathite dharme sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam ||
translation: Truthfulness, purity, compassion, and charity: Dharma is defined in ten essential virtues. Upon the ethical righteous order expounded in Nagara Khanda is the entire society firmly sustained.
meaning: Khanda 6: Nagara Khanda (Hatkeshwar Traditions & Cultural Heritage)

layers.author: gv-tagare
layers.content: Nagara Khanda elaborates social ethics, historical lineages, and temple consecrations that preserved Sanatana Dharma across western India.

layers.author: kashi-scholars
layers.content: सत्य, पवित्रता, दया और दान—धर्म के दस लक्षण कहे गए हैं। नागर खण्ड में वर्णित धर्म पर ही संपूर्ण समाज प्रतिष्ठित रहता है।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: सत्य, शुचिता, दया आणि दान हे धर्माचे मुख्य स्तंभ आहेत. नागर खंडात वर्णन केलेल्या सदाचारावरच मानवी समाज स्थिर राहतो.
